brewing.notes: A common starting point for herbal infusions: boiling water, about five minutes.

description:
A Korean infusion of edible mushrooms in water. Named kinds include neungi-cha from scaly hedgehog, neutari-cha from oyster mushroom, pyogo-cha from shiitake, sanghwang-cha from black hoof mushroom and yeongji-cha from lingzhi.

Brew it as you would other herbal infusions. If the plant is new to you, check that it is safe for you first, especially when pregnant or on medication.
history: Korean mushroom teas are known mainly as this group of types named after the mushroom used. Little more is documented about their history.
